caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, colored rendering of a decorative metal object, likely a fireplace andiron or fender, composed mainly of metallic gold and brass-like hues with subtle shading to indicate form and depth. The primary object has a large, ornate finial on top of a cylindrical and fluted central post, which transitions downward into a wide base supported by three curving legs ending in ball-shaped feet. Attached to the base is a curved panel adorned with openwork, featuring symmetrical scrolls and leafy motifs, supported at the opposite end by a smaller finial on a slender post. The background is a plain, off-white color, and within the upper left quadrant of the drawing, there is a secondary linear outline rendering of the same object, including a side view, drawn in black lines without color or shading. The artist’s name, “Hans Korsch,” is written in the lower right corner of the page. The drawing is framed by a single thin black line close to the page margins, and some small brownish spots are present on the background.
title: Andiron
